title: Crossett Coastal Rental | Loaded 30A Estate | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Crossett Coastal Cottage is a designer 30A retreat with a private pool, golf cart, bikes, fenced yard, and quick access to the beach and Seaside.
description_expanded: Crossett Coastal Cottage Features - Private Pool with tanning shelf, great for little ones to splash around. - Pool heating included for arrivals October 1 - April 30 effective for new reservations starting September 19, 2025. - 1 Minute bike ride to 395 Beach Access. Beach service available at this location - 4 Minute bike ride to Seaside Town Center with lots of shopping and dining options, including the famous Seaside Food Trucks - 2 Blocks to Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market - 5 Taxi Bikes, serviced frequently to ensure they are ready to go when you are ready - 6-seater LSV (golf cart), serviced by La Dolce Vita. Must sign a waiver for access. - Fenced-in AstroTurf backyard, perfect for playtime and touch football games - Covered poolside patio with outdoor dining, Smart TV, and summer kitchen with built-in gas grill - Sundeck with poolside seating and outdoor shower - 1st Floor Main Living Area with Smart TV (fireplace is unavailable) - Gourmet kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances plus wet bar with ice maker - Dining area plus breakfast bar seating - SONOS Sound system - WIFI, cable, and Smart TVs available - King Suite with a pool view on the 1st Floor - 2nd Floor Laundry Room with HE washer and dryer - 2nd Floor Kitchenette with mini fridge and microwave - Kids loft with TV, bean bag chairs, and sleeping for 2 on twin air beds - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles - Concierge services available including grocery delivery, private chef, and baby equipment rentals - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee. Designer home, only 3 blocks from the beach! This luxury home is high-end everything including private pool, outdoor dining with TV, fenced-in AstroTurf backyard, and designer furniture throughout. Your crew will love relaxing in this stunning home. Mixing modern design with beachy chic comfort, you will love the sleek style highlighted with reclaimed and repurposed pieces throughout the home. The fenced-in AstroTurf backyard is fantastic for kids to enjoy the fabulous 30A weather, whether they are splashing in the pool or running around in the yard. Adults will love how conveniently located the home is to the beach, dining, and shopping. Enjoy high-end dining at Surfing Deer or more casual fair at Seagrove Village Market - both are a short walk from the home. You can bike to Seaside in 4 minutes! Set up concierge services, such as grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, a private chef, and beach chair rentals to really take advantage of a 30A vacation experience. Beach chairs can be set up at the 395 Beach Access, only a 1-minute bike ride from the home. All you need to carry with you is your book and your sunscreen! Area Construction - Our area is getting more popular each year! There is a possibility of nearby construction, community changes and projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
